test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: What is the significance of the recent rating assigned to Shriram Finance Limited’s Fixed Deposit Programme? (As of January 2026)

options.text: The programme was downgraded due to rising credit risk
The programme was withdrawn from rating coverage by CARE Ratings
The programme was placed under negative watch due to weak financials
The programme received the highest safety rating reflecting strong credit profile

solution:
The correct answer is __**The programme received the highest safety rating reflecting strong credit profile and stability.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Shriram Finance Limited’s Fixed Deposit Programme was assigned a ‘CARE AAA; Stable’ rating, indicating high safety and strong credit fundamentals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **CARE Ratings assigned ‘CARE AAA; Stable’ to Shriram Finance Limited’s Fixed Deposit Programme, reflecting a high degree of safety in timely servicing of obligations.**
 
• **Several long-term debt instruments and bank facilities were upgraded to ‘CARE AAA; Stable’, while short-term instruments were reaffirmed at ‘CARE A1’.**
 
• **CRISIL assigned a ‘CRISIL AA / Watch Positive’ rating to the Fixed Deposit Programme, indicating potential for an upgrade.**
 
• **ICRA revised its rating to ‘(ICRA) AA’ and placed it on Watch with Positive Implications.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
